mapper.sql:
SELECT r.bsm AS id,r.sscsdm AS city_code,r.
AS source_bridge_key, r.tbsj AS source_updated_at,r.sjtbzt AS sync_status,
r.jcrq AS occurred_at,nullif(trim(r.jcjg),'') IS NULL AS missing_details,false AS unknown_codes,false AS earlier_rectification
r.sbrq::timestamp AS occurred_at,(nullif(trim(r.bhms),'') IS NULL OR nullif(trim(r.bhbh),'') IS NULL OR r.qlbw IS NULL OR r.xjx IS NULL OR r.shlx IS NULL OR r.bhly IS NULL OR r.shcd IS NULL OR r.clzt IS NULL) AS missing_details, (r.qlbw NOT IN(1,2,3,99) OR (r.xjx NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 9 AND r.xjx!=99) OR (r.shlx NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 35 AND r.shlx!=99) OR r.bhly NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR r.shcd NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5 OR r.clzt NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 6) IS TRUE AS unknown_codes,false AS earlier_rectification
r.yhrq::timestamp AS occurred_at,(nullif(trim(r.bhbh),'') IS NULL OR r.wtzgzt IS NULL OR r.yhlx IS NULL) AS missing_details, (r.yhlx NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR r.wtzgzt NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 6) IS TRUE AS unknown_codes, (r.wtzgrq<r.yhrq) IS TRUE AS earlier_rectification
FROM
r WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bridge_keys k JOIN bridge_active b ON b.qlid=k.bridge_id WHERE ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.bridge_key]::text[]=ARRAY[r.sscsdm,r.]::text[]) AND r.sscsdm=#{city}

, quality_keys AS (SELECT sscsdm,bridge_key,min(bridge_id) AS bridge_id,count(*) AS matches FROM bridge_keys GROUP BY 1,2), raw AS NOT MATERIALIZED (), audited AS ( SELECT r.*,CASE WHEN k.matches=1 THEN k.bridge_id END AS bridge_id,k.matches, concat_ws(',', CASE WHEN nullif(trim(r.id),'') IS NULL OR nullif(trim(r.city_code),'') IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_IDENTIFIER' END, CASE WHEN nullif(trim(r.source_bridge_key),'') IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_BRIDGE_KEY' END, CASE WHEN k.matches IS NULL THEN 'UNMATCHED_BRIDGE' END,CASE WHEN k.matches>1 THEN 'AMBIGUOUS_BRIDGE' END, CASE WHEN r.occurred_at IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_DATE' END, CASE WHEN r.occurred_at::date>(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date THEN 'FUTURE_DATE' END, CASE WHEN r.source_updated_at IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_SYNC_TIME' END, CASE WHEN r.missing_details THEN 'MISSING_DETAILS' END,CASE WHEN r.unknown_codes THEN 'UNKNOWN_CODE' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(r.sync_status,'') NOT IN ('','I','U','D') THEN 'UNKNOWN_SYNC_STATUS' END, CASE WHEN r.earlier_rectification THEN 'RECTIFIED_BEFORE_MAINTENANCE' END ) AS issue_codes FROM raw r LEFT JOIN quality_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.bridge_key]::text[]=ARRAY[r.city_code,r.source_bridge_key]::text[] )
mapper.select: , key_stats AS ( SELECT count(*) AS distinct_keys,coalesce(sum(n-1),0)::bigint AS duplicate_excess FROM ( SELECT city_code,id,count(*) AS n FROM raw WHERE nullif(trim(id),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(city_code),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ) grouped ) SELECT count(*) AS raw_rows,(SELECT distinct_keys FROM key_stats),(SELECT duplicate_excess FROM key_stats), count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(trim(id),'') IS NULL OR nullif(trim(city_code),'') IS NULL) AS missing_identifiers, count(*) FILTER(WHERE sync_status='D') AS deleted_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE matches=1) AS mapped_rows, count(*) FILTER(WHERE matches IS NULL) AS unmatched_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE matches>1) AS ambiguous_rows, count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(trim(source_bridge_key),'') IS NULL) AS missing_bridge_keys, count(*) FILTER(WHERE occurred_at IS NULL) AS missing_dates, count(*) FILTER(WHERE occurred_at::date>(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) AS future_dates, count(*) FILTER(WHERE source_updated_at IS NULL) AS missing_sync_times, count(*) FILTER(WHERE missing_details) AS missing_details, count(*) FILTER(WHERE unknown_codes) AS unknown_codes, count(*) FILTER(WHERE coalesce(sync_status,'') NOT IN ('','I','U','D')) AS unknown_sync_status, count(*) FILTER(WHERE earlier_rectification) AS earlier_rectification, min(occurred_at) AS first_date,max(occurred_at) AS last_date,max(source_updated_at) AS latest_sync FROM audited

SELECT r.id,r.city_code,r.source_bridge_key,r.bridge_id,r.occurred_at,r.source_updated_at,r.sync_status,r.issue_codes,count(*) OVER() AS matching_total FROM audited r
ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,r.city_code,r.id,r.source_bridge_key,r.source_updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,r.sync_status LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

, unique_keys AS (SELECT sscsdm,bridge_key,min(bridge_id) AS bridge_id FROM bridge_keys GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)=1 AND min(bridge_id) IN(SELECT qlid FROM bridge_active)), defect_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(sscsdm,bsm) * FROM dwd_ql_jg_jcbhxx_all r WHERE nullif(trim(bsm),'') IS NOT NULL AND sscsdm=#{city} ORDER BY sscsdm,bsm,tbsj DESC NULLS LAST,(sjtbzt='D') DESC NULLS LAST,extract_time DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC ), maintenance_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(sscsdm,bsm) * FROM dwd_ql_jg_yhwxxx_all r WHERE nullif(trim(bsm),'') IS NOT NULL AND sscsdm=#{city} ORDER BY sscsdm,bsm,tbsj DESC NULLS LAST,(sjtbzt='D') DESC NULLS LAST,extract_time DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC ), defect_codes AS ( SELECT d.sscsdm,k.bridge_id,d.bhbh,count(*) AS matches FROM defect_latest d JOIN unique_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.bridge_key]::text[]=ARRAY[d.sscsdm,d.qlbh]::text[] WHERE coalesce(d.sjtbzt,'')!='D' AND nullif(trim(d.bhbh),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ), maintenance_refs AS ( SELECT m.*,k.bridge_id FROM maintenance_latest m JOIN unique_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.bridge_key]::text[]=ARRAY[m.sscsdm,m.qlbh]::text[] WHERE coalesce(m.sjtbzt,'')!='D' ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM defect_codes WHERE matches>1) AS duplicate_defect_codes, count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.matches=1) AS unique_maintenance, count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.matches IS NULL AND nullif(trim(m.bhbh),'') IS NOT NULL) AS unmatched_maintenance, count(*) FILTER(WHERE d.matches>1) AS ambiguous_maintenance, count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(trim(m.bhbh),'') IS NULL) AS missing_reference_keys FROM maintenance_refs m LEFT JOIN defect_codes d ON (d.sscsdm,d.bridge_id,d.bhbh)=(m.sscsdm,m.bridge_id,m.bhbh)
